svg.text: Who you are is part of the chrome
The footer names the signed-in clinician, their role and their
discipline — the same facts that decide what they may edit.
Sync state is permanent, not a toast
Synced, Syncing or Offline sits in the header on every screen,
so nobody has to wonder whether a note left the tablet.
The day opens with what is owed
overdue. Each strip links to the work, not a count.
“38 of 96 achieved” sits beside “62% average progress”,
so steady work on long-term goals never reads as failure.
Draft and Signed are states, not styling
The chip carries the legal standing of the record. An unsigned
note is visibly incomplete wherever it appears in the app.
Admin is absent, not greyed out
Therapists never see the item at all, matching the
Postgres rule rather than hiding a door they can open.
